operations.source_case: current offer acceptance by intended participant/verified guardian or authorised staff
operations.consistency_rule: Validate the same offer/hold/participant/capacity/current authority, then update offer and original booking reservation as one source operation. One hold/booking effect; accepting offer does not claim paid/confirmed until booking finalisation gates pass. Component names are projections/aliases, not two independently replayed allocation commands.

operations.source_case: supplier_quote only; variations/work verification/other decisions choose their own exact source permission and command
operations.consistency_rule: Validate exact quote/version/amount/validity/independent authority. Publish one decision+quote outcome+unique commitment as one source operation. Commitment identity unique per accepted quote version; either UI entry reuses original operation/result, never creates a second spend commitment.

operations.source_case: actual capture on same immutable issue and intended signer
operations.consistency_rule: One signature evidence record per supported capture identity/issue/signer; compute remaining required signers from current issue. Partial capture retains awaiting state; final required capture changes aggregate issue to SIGNED. Supersession never rewrites signature facts.

runtime_boundary: Logical consistency requirements, not a claim that remote provider effects are one database transaction. OpenKBS maps actual transaction/idempotency/constraints and tests concurrent entry points.
